basics.name: Niharika Vadlamudi
basics.label: Research Intern, Microsoft Research (CARE Team)
basics.summary: Researcher working on document image analysis and medical vision-language models. MS by Research (part-time), IIIT Hyderabad. Formerly Software Developer I at Microsoft.

work.name: Microsoft Research
highlights: Led coordination with Narayana Health hospitals, managing dataset access and driving model evaluations across incremental versions against clinically defined exit criteria spanning multiple pathologies.
Developed an optimized multimodal VLM for rare and critical ICU pathologies, leveraging a discriminative loss to reinforce cross-entropy loss within a VLM setting.
Led tube detection and abnormality placement efforts — including dataset creation, model training, and evaluation — for classifying tube placement and associated abnormalities.
Developed an aortic dilatation detection pipeline, independently collaborating with the NH team on a novel geometric approach for detecting ascending aortic enlargement (AAE).
Conducted a systematic literature review of radiology foundation and baseline models, collating published benchmark results for comparative analysis.

work.name: Microsoft
work.position: Software Developer I, Torus Buildout (Experiences + Devices)
highlights: Automated and optimized cloud orchestration workflows, enabling two critical role bring-ups and reducing buildout time by approximately 5%.
Developed and deployed a configurable certificate provisioning workflow in CredSMART, adding support for publishing public trusted root and public certificates to Azure Active Directory.
Integrated the Torus SecretsBootstrapper service with two core services for end-to-end enablement of secret management in upcoming sovereign cloud pipelines.
Conducted integration testing for 30+ CredSMART APIs, supporting 100+ partner teams in secure service key and certificate workflows.
Automated core security services (Lockbox, IDM) using the Buildout Coordinator Tool, improving reliability and minimizing manual effort.
Implemented the Torus Configuration Syncer Service, enabling dynamic, code-free configuration management across multiple datacenter services.

work.name: IIIT Delhi — Vision Lab
work.summary: Collaborated with Dr. Saket Anand on the government-funded project 'Automated Road Inspection using Videos for E-Marg'.
highlights: Fine-tuned state-of-the-art vision models (DeepLabV3+, SAM, EfficientNet) for small-scale datasets; developed an integrated model exhibiting a 6% increase in accuracy for Road Quality Assessment.
Researched novel Active Learning (AL) methods and frame selection strategies for video modalities to reduce annotation costs for large-scale raw data.

work.name: CVIT, IIIT Hyderabad
work.summary: Collaborated with Dr. Ravi Kiran S investigating interdisciplinary methodologies for analyzing text layouts within historical palm leaf manuscripts.
highlights: Work culminated in a Master's thesis and two publications (SeamFormer, LineTR).
Implemented the SeamFormer model into the Bhashini platform to facilitate processing of ancient Indic manuscripts, supporting 1000+ users and academicians.

work.name: IHub-Data, IIIT Hyderabad
work.summary: Worked with Dr. UD Priyakumar on computational drug design for de novo molecular generation.
highlights: Extended state-of-the-art baseline models for multi-property prediction on the Harvard Therapeutics Data Commons (TDC) ADMET dataset.
Designed GNN encoder-decoder architectures (GIN, GAT, GCN) for molecular property prediction.

work.name: Microsoft
work.position: Software Intern, IC3 Admin Scenarios Team
highlights: Enhanced pagination and search features in Modern Portal (MoPo) Admin, improving admin workflow efficiency and user experience.
Designed and implemented Azure Cosmos DB (NoSQL) APIs to drive performance benchmarking and enable COGS optimization for custom Azure server configurations.
Developed a scalable data ingestion tool handling millions of records, leading to multi-million-dollar cost savings across cloud operations.

work.name: Microsoft
work.summary: Selected for the Microsoft Codess Program (2020), a competitive initiative to empower women in software engineering.
highlights: Designed and implemented a mini Mars Rover navigation system using core AI path planning algorithms (A*, Dijkstra's, DFS, Bidirectional BFS) with a focus on ethical AI principles.
Offered a direct internship opportunity for Summer 2021 based on performance.

work.name: Medha Servo Drive
highlights: Developed and prototyped a four-way traffic light controller as an embedded hardware system, using Xilinx Verilog implemented on FPGA boards.
Contributed to the design and testing phases, ensuring functionality and reliability.
